verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs say Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new pull request in selected repositories. It catches bugs and suggests fixes with no configuration, and paid plans list unlimited AI reviews, which covers review at volume. Custom rules and comment exclusions let teams set the bar the reviewer enforces. GT MCP also lets AI agents split large AI-generated changes into smaller stacked PRs that are easier to review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence that the reviewer catches real problems in agent-authored code at scale, and any documentation of review behavior specific to AI-authored PRs (e.g., gating or blocking merges).
